content:
The side lengths are positive integers summing to 7.  
Triangle inequality requires each side to be less than half of 7, so each side is at most 3.

Unordered triples with positive integers summing to 7 and each \(\le 3\) are:
\[
(3,3,1),\quad (3,2,2)
\]
Both satisfy the triangle inequality.

Thus the number of different triangles is \(\boxed{2}\).
